objections.claim: The claimed whole-tree no-listener invariant is unsound: the seccomp filter denies only direct bind/listen/accept/accept4 syscalls, but modern Linux exposes IORING_OP_SOCKET, IORING_OP_BIND, IORING_OP_LISTEN, and IORING_OP_ACCEPT through io_uring. Their operation codes reside in shared submission-queue memory and are not discriminable from io_uring_enter's scalar syscall arguments, so a native descendant can create a listener without invoking any denied syscall. The plan must fail closed by denying the io_uring syscall family before Node executes (and closing inherited ring descriptors), or provide an equivalently kernel-enforced construction; then add a regression that opens a listener through io_uring and proves denial inside the descendant/private namespace. Until then, PD-001's testable local-single-user boundary and the assertion that indirect/compiler-emitted listener paths are kernel-denied are false.
